name: Village Hotel Bournemouth
beachAccess: Short drive to Boscombe, Southbourne and Christchurch
confirmedFeatures: Spa, indoor pool, health club, restaurant, bar, Starbucks
overview: A 116-room hotel on Deansleigh Road, a short drive inland from Southbourne, Boscombe and Christchurch. It has free parking, an indoor pool, spa and gym, plus a restaurant and bar.
surfTripFit: Free parking and a pool make it a practical drive-in base for the Southbourne beaches.
